sourceInspectionFindings.finding: The default permission handler selects the first option when no callback exists.
sourceInspectionFindings.requiredDisposition: Provide an explicit deny-by-default Hub-bound handler and firing denial tests.

sourceInspectionFindings.finding: The child process environment merges process.env with configured values.
sourceInspectionFindings.requiredDisposition: Launch the adapter through a minimal allowlisted wrapper environment; passing an env override alone is insufficient.

sourceInspectionFindings.finding: Default Workspace and session cwd can resolve to process.cwd(), and session persistence is enabled by default.
sourceInspectionFindings.requiredDisposition: Require the exact guarded remote Workspace, isolated cwd and Change/CodingSession-bound lifecycle.

sourceInspectionFindings.finding: retryOnDead can create or reconnect and retry an operation after sandbox death.
sourceInspectionFindings.requiredDisposition: Disable or override replay for every write-capable operation and quarantine physical-incarnation mismatch.

sourceInspectionFindings.finding: A missing preferred sandbox can fall through to logical-ID discovery/create, and template fallback can rebuild or use a default.
sourceInspectionFindings.requiredDisposition: CONTINUE_LINEAGE requires an owner-bound expected sandboxId; refuse replacement and template fallback.

sourceInspectionFindings.finding: Protocol cancel, process exit or pause does not by itself prove guest quiescence or exclude late output.
sourceInspectionFindings.requiredDisposition: Verify process termination, fence late output by run/incarnation and kill or quarantine the sandbox.

sourceInspectionFindings.finding: Peer ranges allow the proposed combination, but the packages were published from different exact Mastra source commits and range compatibility is not executable compatibility proof.
sourceInspectionFindings.requiredDisposition: Exercise the exact locked combination in RB-C1 and stop on any version-specific behavioral or type incompatibility.

sourceInspectionFindings.finding: The exact source advertises internal ACP clientInfo version 0.1.0 even though the npm package is 0.4.1.
sourceInspectionFindings.requiredDisposition: Bind identity to the package, lock, executable and observed protocol handshake; never infer protocol or adapter revision from that display field.

sourceInspectionFindings.finding: Immutable asset identity and SHA-256 do not make an unadmitted executable safe to start on the Conexus control plane, even with only --version or no-prompt ACP arguments.
sourceInspectionFindings.requiredDisposition: RB-C1 may execute the exact asset only inside a dedicated credential-free E2B sandbox; any host spawn path fails before the first executable instruction.

sourceInspectionFindings.finding: An E2B-confined ACP executable can still request client-side filesystem or terminal actions across the relay unless the control-side client advertises and enforces a deny-by-default capability surface.
sourceInspectionFindings.requiredDisposition: For RB-C1 advertise no control-plane filesystem or terminal capability, deny every agent-to-client action request and prove the denial fires; any future remote Workspace mediation requires its own exact trust-boundary design.

sourceInspectionFindings.finding: An account-scoped E2B credential can address pre-existing templates or sandboxes even when the grant bounds newly created resources.
sourceInspectionFindings.requiredDisposition: Allow mutation only of template and sandbox IDs created and recorded by the exact RB-C1 run; refuse every pre-existing or foreign resource ID before mutation.
